title: Agent Lord passive request v1
description: One registered but not necessarily dispatched instruction. Registration is not authorization and not a dispatch: only an explicit request-dispatch turns a request into an operation.

status.description: Registration and operation binding only. Whether the provider received or completed the message is the operation's own status and delivery evidence.

options.description: Dispatch options frozen at registration, using the same names start accepts. They are validated against the live execution contract at dispatch, never at registration.

intent_sha256.description: Identity of what this request asks for. The same request_id with the same digest is re-entrant; a different digest is a REQUEST_CONFLICT and never overwrites the original.

user_request.description: The user's original instruction, preserved so a restarted scheduler can still explain what was promised.

source.description: Descriptive provenance for filtering only. It is never an identity, an authorization, or an Observer allowlist input.

operation_id.description: Projection of the association that the operation record itself commits atomically through its own request_id field.
